'Build outputs': scans compile straight to TTF/woff2 with no UFO and no hand-editing, so a
font editor is never in the loop. A hand-edited source could not be regenerated from the
scans, which would break the determinism convention the rest of the pipeline runs on.
taste_principles §3.2: 'Set generous sidebearings and kern only the pairs that actually
collide. Over-kerning makes it look like a font, which defeats the point.' So this list
should stay short — a few dozen entries, not a full matrix. If a pair is not visibly
colliding at 120 px, leave it out.
Each entry applies to every alternate of both characters, so one line covers all 400
